faq.a: Noraidah is associated with the Arabic form نُورْ عَائِدَة, whose core sense is noraidah; light returning (malay form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Noraidah?
faq.a: Noraidah is associated with Arabic. Noraidah is a Malay compound of Arabic نُور (nūr, 'light') + عَائِدَة (ʿĀʾida).
Yes — the underlying form نُورْ عَائِدَة is Arabic.
Noraidah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Noraidah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nūr occurs in the Quran as a term for light.

faq.a: In Urdu, Noraidah is rendered نور عائدہ and carries the sense نور عائدہ، واپس آنے والی روشنی.

faq.q: What does Noraidah mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Noraidah is rendered نور عایده and carries the sense نور عایده، نور بازگشته.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Noraidah, noraidah. Script forms are نور عائدہ, نور عايده, نور عایده, نُورْ عَائِدَة, नूर ऐदा.
